Continue computing powers of 10 modulo 31:

\[
10^5\equiv 25\equiv -6 \pmod{31}
\]
\[
10^6\equiv -60\equiv 2,\quad 10^7\equiv 20,\quad 10^8\equiv 14,\quad 10^9\equiv 16,
\]
\[
10^{10}\equiv 5,\quad 10^{11}\equiv 19,\quad 10^{12}\equiv 4,\quad 10^{13}\equiv 9,
\]
\[
10^{14}\equiv 28,\quad 10^{15}\equiv 1 \pmod{31}.
\]

Thus the order of \(10\) modulo \(31\) is \(15\). Since modulo \(9\), \(10\equiv 1\), the congruence

\[
10^{n+1}\equiv 1 \pmod{279}
\]

requires \(n+1\) to be a multiple of \(15\). The smallest such positive \(n\) is

\[
n=15-1=14.
\]

\[
\boxed{14}
\]
